#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Qualification controller: cap removal (left) + peg insertion (right).

Right-arm Cartesian is a few mm off (shoulder/wrist servo swap, uncalibrated).
Built-in pick misses the peg. This controller grasps from vision coordinates,
aligns the peg lower end to the socket hole with vision feedback, inserts
until contact force stalls the descent, then releases so the peg seats.
"""
import re
import sys
import workcell

def log(msg):
    print(msg, flush=True)

def status_text():
    return workcell.robot("status").text

def robot_time():
    t = status_text()
    m = re.search(r"robot time used (\S+)", t)
    return m.group(1) if m else "?"

def locate():
    t = workcell.call("vision", "locate").text
    d = {"raw": t}
    m = re.search(r"socket hole centre: x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) mm, top at z=([-\d.]+)", t)
    if m:
        d["hole"] = (float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2)), float(m.group(3)))
    m = re.search(r"peg: centre x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+).*lower end x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+).*tilt ([-\d.]+)", t)
    if m:
        d["peg"] = {
            "c": (float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2)), float(m.group(3))),
            "low": (float(m.group(4)), float(m.group(5)), float(m.group(6))),
            "tilt": float(m.group(7)),
        }
    m = re.search(r"cap: centre x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+)", t)
    if m:
        d["cap"] = (float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2)), float(m.group(3)))
    return d

def holding(arm):
    t = status_text()
    return f"{arm} arm:" in t and "closed on an object" in t.split(f"{arm} arm:")[1].split("\n")[0]

def tcp(arm):
    t = status_text()
    m = re.search(rf"{arm} arm: TCP at x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+)", t)
    return tuple(float(x) for x in m.groups())

def grip(arm, state):
    r = workcell.robot("grip", arm, state)
    log(f"grip {arm} {state}: {r.text}")
    return r

def move(arm, x, y, z):
    r = workcell.robot("move", arm, f"{x:.1f}", f"{y:.1f}", f"{z:.1f}")
    log(f"move {arm} {x:.1f},{y:.1f},{z:.1f}: {r.text}")
    return r

def step(arm, dx, dy, dz):
    r = workcell.robot("step", arm, f"{dx:.1f}", f"{dy:.1f}", f"{dz:.1f}")
    return r

def grasp_peg():
    grip("right", "open")
    vis = locate()
    if "peg" not in vis:
        log("no peg visible")
        return False
    px, py, pz = vis["peg"]["c"]
    log(f"peg centre {px:.1f},{py:.1f},{pz:.1f} tilt {vis['peg']['tilt']:.1f}")
    # approach above, then to mid-height grasp (clear of the holder, around the peg centre)
    move("right", px, py, 160)
    grasp_z = max(40.0, min(70.0, pz + 4.0))
    move("right", px, py, grasp_z)
    grip("right", "close")
    if holding("right"):
        log("grasped on first try")
        return True
    log("first grasp empty, searching")
    grip("right", "open")
    # spiral around the vision point
    offsets = [(8,0),(-8,0),(0,8),(0,-8),(8,8),(-8,8),(8,-8),(-8,-8),(12,0),(-12,0),(0,12),(0,-12)]
    for dx, dy in offsets:
        move("right", px+dx, py+dy, grasp_z + 30)
        move("right", px+dx, py+dy, grasp_z)
        grip("right", "close")
        if holding("right"):
            log(f"grasped at offset {dx},{dy}")
            return True
        grip("right", "open")
    return False

def align_to_hole(z_cmd, tol=1.2, n=5):
    """Move so peg lower end is over the hole, keeping current height roughly."""
    hole = locate().get("hole", (0.0, 60.0, 55.0))
    hx, hy = hole[0], hole[1]
    for i in range(n):
        samples = []
        for _ in range(2):
            vis = locate()
            if "peg" not in vis:
                log("peg lost during align")
                return False
            samples.append(vis["peg"]["low"])
        lx = sum(s[0] for s in samples) / len(samples)
        ly = sum(s[1] for s in samples) / len(samples)
        lz = samples[-1][2]
        dx, dy = hx - lx, hy - ly
        log(f"align {i}: lower {lx:.2f},{ly:.2f},{lz:.1f} err {dx:.2f},{dy:.2f}")
        if abs(dx) <= tol and abs(dy) <= tol:
            return True
        # clamp
        dx = max(-15, min(15, dx))
        dy = max(-15, min(15, dy))
        # step in <=20 mm pieces (already clamped)
        r = step("right", dx, dy, 0)
        log(f"  step {r.text}")
        if not r.ok:
            return False
    vis = locate()
    if "peg" not in vis:
        return False
    lx, ly, lz = vis["peg"]["low"]
    log(f"align end lower {lx:.2f},{ly:.2f},{lz:.1f}")
    return abs(hx - lx) < 2.5 and abs(hy - ly) < 2.5

def insert():
    # lift clear
    cx, cy, cz = tcp("right")
    move("right", cx, cy, max(cz, 170))
    # go above hole
    move("right", 0, 60, 170)
    if not align_to_hole(170):
        log("align high failed, continuing")
    # drop to just above contact, then realign (xy drifts with height)
    cx, cy, cz = tcp("right")
    move("right", cx, cy, 115)
    if not align_to_hole(115):
        log("align low imperfect, continuing")
    # press in
    stalled = 0
    last_z = tcp("right")[2]
    for i in range(18):
        r = step("right", 0, 0, -4)
        log(f"insert {i}: {r.text}")
        m = re.search(r"z=([-\d.]+).*Fz=([+-]?[\d.]+)", r.text)
        if not m:
            if not r.ok:
                break
            continue
        z = float(m.group(1))
        fz = float(m.group(2))
        if abs(z - last_z) < 0.6:
            stalled += 1
        else:
            stalled = 0
        last_z = z
        if abs(fz) > 8 and stalled >= 1:
            log("contact stall, releasing")
            break
        if z < 62 and abs(fz) > 6:
            log("depth + force, releasing")
            break
    grip("right", "open")
    # back off
    cx, cy, cz = tcp("right")
    move("right", cx, cy, 180)
    vis = locate()
    log("post-release vision: " + vis["raw"].replace("\n", " | "))
    if "peg" in vis:
        lowz = vis["peg"]["low"][2]
        tilt = vis["peg"]["tilt"]
        log(f"lower z={lowz:.1f} tilt={tilt:.1f}")
        if lowz > 22:
            log("not seated, pushing top")
            push_top(vis)
            vis = locate()
            log("after push: " + vis["raw"].replace("\n", " | "))
    return vis

def push_top(vis):
    c = vis["peg"]["c"]
    # top of 90 mm peg is ~45 mm above centre
    top_z = c[2] + 45
    grip("right", "close")
    move("right", c[0], c[1], top_z + 40)
    move("right", c[0], c[1], max(100, top_z - 5))
    # press down a bit
    for i in range(8):
        r = step("right", 0, 0, -3)
        log(f"push {i}: {r.text}")
        m = re.search(r"Fz=([+-]?[\d.]+)", r.text)
        if m and abs(float(m.group(1))) > 12:
            break
    grip("right", "open")
    cx, cy, cz = tcp("right")
    move("right", 80, 20, 200)

def run():
    log("=== trial start ===")
    r = workcell.call("trial", "start")
    log(r.text)
    if not r.ok:
        return 1
    log("time " + robot_time())
    log(status_text())

    log("--- remove cap ---")
    r = workcell.robot("pick", "cap", "--arm", "left")
    log(r.text)
    if not r.ok:
        log("cap pick failed")
        end()
        return 1
    r = workcell.robot("place", "bin", "--arm", "left")
    log(r.text)
    if not r.ok:
        log("cap place failed")
        end()
        return 1
    # park left
    move("left", -180, -10, 300)
    log("time after cap " + robot_time())

    log("--- grasp peg ---")
    if not grasp_peg():

    log("time after grasp " + robot_time())

    log("--- insert ---")
    insert()
    # park right clear of socket
    move("right", 160, -10, 280)
    move("left", -180, -10, 300)
    log("time before end " + robot_time())
    log(workcell.robot("scene").text)
    return end()

def end():
    r = workcell.call("trial", "end")
    log("=== trial end ===")
    log(r.text)
    log(workcell.call("trial", "status").text)
    return 0 if r.ok else 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(run())

    return workcell.robot("status").text

def robot_time():
    t = status_text()
    m = re.search(r"robot time used (\S+)", t)
    return m.group(1) if m else "?"

def locate():
    t = workcell.call("vision", "locate").text
    d = {"raw": t}
    m = re.search(r"socket hole centre: x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) mm, top at z=([-\d.]+)", t)
    if m:
        d["hole"] = (float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2)), float(m.group(3)))
    m = re.search(r"peg: centre x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+).*lower end x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+).*tilt ([-\d.]+)", t)
    if m:
        d["peg"] = {
            "c": (float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2)), float(m.group(3))),
            "low": (float(m.group(4)), float(m.group(5)), float(m.group(6))),
            "tilt": float(m.group(7)),
        }
    m = re.search(r"cap: centre x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+)", t)
    if m:
        d["cap"] = (float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2)), float(m.group(3)))
    return d

def holding(arm):
    t = status_text()
    return f"{arm} arm:" in t and "closed on an object" in t.split(f"{arm} arm:")[1].split("\n")[0]

def tcp(arm):
    t = status_text()
    m = re.search(rf"{arm} arm: TCP at x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+)", t)
    return tuple(float(x) for x in m.groups())

def grip(arm, state):
    r = workcell.robot("grip", arm, state)
    log(f"grip {arm} {state}: {r.text}")
    return r

def move(arm, x, y, z):
    r = workcell.robot("move", arm, f"{x:.1f}", f"{y:.1f}", f"{z:.1f}")
    log(f"move {arm} {x:.1f},{y:.1f},{z:.1f}: {r.text}")
    return r

def step(arm, dx, dy, dz):
    r = workcell.robot("step", arm, f"{dx:.1f}", f"{dy:.1f}", f"{dz:.1f}")
    return r

def grasp_peg():
    grip("right", "open")
    vis = locate()
    if "peg" not in vis:
        log("no peg visible")
        return False
    px, py, pz = vis["peg"]["c"]
    log(f"peg centre {px:.1f},{py:.1f},{pz:.1f} tilt {vis['peg']['tilt']:.1f}")
    # approach above, then to mid-height grasp (clear of the holder, around the peg centre)
    move("right", px, py, 160)
    grasp_z = max(40.0, min(70.0, pz + 4.0))
    move("right", px, py, grasp_z)
    grip("right", "close")
    if holding("right"):
        log("grasped on first try")
        return True
    log("first grasp empty, searching")
    grip("right", "open")
    # spiral around the vision point
    offsets = [(8,0),(-8,0),(0,8),(0,-8),(8,8),(-8,8),(8,-8),(-8,-8),(12,0),(-12,0),(0,12),(0,-12)]
    for dx, dy in offsets:
        move("right", px+dx, py+dy, grasp_z + 30)
        move("right", px+dx, py+dy, grasp_z)
        grip("right", "close")
        if holding("right"):
            log(f"grasped at offset {dx},{dy}")
            return True
        grip("right", "open")
    return False

def align_to_hole(z_cmd, tol=1.2, n=5):
    """Move so peg lower end is over the hole, keeping current height roughly."""
    hole = locate().get("hole", (0.0, 60.0, 55.0))
    hx, hy = hole[0], hole[1]
    for i in range(n):
        samples = []
        for _ in range(2):
            vis = locate()
            if "peg" not in vis:
                log("peg lost during align")
                return False
            samples.append(vis["peg"]["low"])
        lx = sum(s[0] for s in samples) / len(samples)
        ly = sum(s[1] for s in samples) / len(samples)
        lz = samples[-1][2]
        dx, dy = hx - lx, hy - ly
        log(f"align {i}: lower {lx:.2f},{ly:.2f},{lz:.1f} err {dx:.2f},{dy:.2f}")
        if abs(dx) <= tol and abs(dy) <= tol:
            return True
        # clamp
        dx = max(-15, min(15, dx))
        dy = max(-15, min(15, dy))
        # step in <=20 mm pieces (already clamped)
        r = step("right", dx, dy, 0)
        log(f"  step {r.text}")
        if not r.ok:
            return False
    vis = locate()
    if "peg" not in vis:
        return False
    lx, ly, lz = vis["peg"]["low"]
    log(f"align end lower {lx:.2f},{ly:.2f},{lz:.1f}")
    return abs(hx - lx) < 2.5 and abs(hy - ly) < 2.5

def insert():
    # lift clear
    cx, cy, cz = tcp("right")
    move("right", cx, cy, max(cz, 170))
    # go above hole
    move("right", 0, 60, 170)
    if not align_to_hole(170):
        log("align high failed, continuing")
    # drop to just above contact, then realign (xy drifts with height)
    cx, cy, cz = tcp("right")
    move("right", cx, cy, 115)
    if not align_to_hole(115):
        log("align low imperfect, continuing")
    # press in
    stalled = 0
    last_z = tcp("right")[2]
    for i in range(18):
        r = step("right", 0, 0, -4)
        log(f"insert {i}: {r.text}")
        m = re.search(r"z=([-\d.]+).*Fz=([+-]?[\d.]+)", r.text)
        if not m:
            if not r.ok:
                break
            continue
        z = float(m.group(1))
        fz = float(m.group(2))
        if abs(z - last_z) < 0.6:
            stalled += 1
        else:
            stalled = 0
        last_z = z
        if abs(fz) > 8 and stalled >= 1:
            log("contact stall, releasing")
            break
        if z < 62 and abs(fz) > 6:
            log("depth + force, releasing")
            break
    grip("right", "open")
    # back off
    cx, cy, cz = tcp("right")
    move("right", cx, cy, 180)
    vis = locate()
    log("post-release vision: " + vis["raw"].replace("\n", " | "))
    if "peg" in vis:
        lowz = vis["peg"]["low"][2]
        tilt = vis["peg"]["tilt"]
        log(f"lower z={lowz:.1f} tilt={tilt:.1f}")

            push_top(vis)
            vis = locate()
            log("after push: " + vis["raw"].replace("\n", " | "))
    return vis

def push_top(vis):
    c = vis["peg"]["c"]
    # top of 90 mm peg is ~45 mm above centre
    top_z = c[2] + 45
    grip("right", "close")
    move("right", c[0], c[1], top_z + 40)
    move("right", c[0], c[1], max(100, top_z - 5))
    # press down a bit
    for i in range(8):
        r = step("right", 0, 0, -3)
        log(f"push {i}: {r.text}")
        m = re.search(r"Fz=([+-]?[\d.]+)", r.text)
        if m and abs(float(m.group(1))) > 12:

    cx, cy, cz = tcp("right")
    move("right", 80, 20, 200)

def run():

    r = workcell.call("trial", "start")
    log(r.text)
    if not r.ok:

    log("time " + robot_time())
    log(status_text())

    log("--- remove cap ---")
    r = workcell.robot("pick", "cap", "--arm", "left")

    r = workcell.robot("place", "bin", "--arm", "left")

    move("right", 160, -10, 280)
    move("left", -180, -10, 300)
    log("time before end " + robot_time())
    log(workcell.robot("scene").text)

    r = workcell.call("trial", "end")
    log("=== trial end ===")
    log(r.text)
    log(workcell.call("trial", "status").text)

cat > /tmp/insert_trial.py << 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Qualification controller: cap removal (left) + peg insertion (right).

Right-arm Cartesian is a few mm off (shoulder/wrist servo swap, uncalibrated).
Built-in pick misses the peg. This controller grasps from vision coordinates,
aligns the peg lower end to the socket hole with vision feedback, inserts
until contact force stalls the descent, then releases so the peg seats.
"""
import re
import sys
import workcell

def log(msg):
    print(msg, flush=True)

def status_text():
    return workcell.robot("status").text

def robot_time():
    t = status_text()
    m = re.search(r"robot time used (\S+)", t)
    return m.group(1) if m else "?"

def locate():
    t = workcell.call("vision", "locate").text
    d = {"raw": t}
    m = re.search(r"socket hole centre: x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) mm, top at z=([-\d.]+)", t)
    if m:
        d["hole"] = (float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2)), float(m.group(3)))
    m = re.search(r"peg: centre x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+).*lower end x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+).*tilt ([-\d.]+)", t)
    if m:
        d["peg"] = {
            "c": (float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2)), float(m.group(3))),
            "low": (float(m.group(4)), float(m.group(5)), float(m.group(6))),
            "tilt": float(m.group(7)),
        }
    m = re.search(r"cap: centre x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+)", t)
    if m:
        d["cap"] = (float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2)), float(m.group(3)))
    return d

def holding(arm):
    t = status_text()
    return f"{arm} arm:" in t and "closed on an object" in t.split(f"{arm} arm:")[1].split("\n")[0]

def tcp(arm):
    t = status_text()
    m = re.search(rf"{arm} arm: TCP at x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+)", t)
    return tuple(float(x) for x in m.groups())

def grip(arm, state):
    r = workcell.robot("grip", arm, state)
    log(f"grip {arm} {state}: {r.text}")
    return r

def move(arm, x, y, z):
    r = workcell.robot("move", arm, f"{x:.1f}", f"{y:.1f}", f"{z:.1f}")
    log(f"move {arm} {x:.1f},{y:.1f},{z:.1f}: {r.text}")
    return r

def step(arm, dx, dy, dz):
    r = workcell.robot("step", arm, f"{dx:.1f}", f"{dy:.1f}", f"{dz:.1f}")
    return r

def grasp_peg():
    grip("right", "open")
    vis = locate()
    if "peg" not in vis:
        log("no peg visible")
        return False
    px, py, pz = vis["peg"]["c"]
    log(f"peg centre {px:.1f},{py:.1f},{pz:.1f} tilt {vis['peg']['tilt']:.1f}")
    # approach above, then to mid-height grasp (clear of the holder, around the peg centre)
    move("right", px, py, 160)
    grasp_z = max(40.0, min(70.0, pz + 4.0))
    move("right", px, py, grasp_z)
    grip("right", "close")
    if holding("right"):
        log("grasped on first try")
        return True
    log("first grasp empty, searching")
    grip("right", "open")
    # spiral around the vision point
    offsets = [(8,0),(-8,0),(0,8),(0,-8),(8,8),(-8,8),(8,-8),(-8,-8),(12,0),(-12,0),(0,12),(0,-12)]
    for dx, dy in offsets:
        move("right", px+dx, py+dy, grasp_z + 30)
        move("right", px+dx, py+dy, grasp_z)
        grip("right", "close")
        if holding("right"):
            log(f"grasped at offset {dx},{dy}")
            return True
        grip("right", "open")
    return False

def align_to_hole(z_cmd, tol=1.2, n=5):
    """Move so peg lower end is over the hole, keeping current height roughly."""
    hole = locate().get("hole", (0.0, 60.0, 55.0))
    hx, hy = hole[0], hole[1]
    for i in range(n):
        samples = []
        for _ in range(2):
            vis = locate()
            if "peg" not in vis:
                log("peg lost during align")
                return False
            samples.append(vis["peg"]["low"])
        lx = sum(s[0] for s in samples) / len(samples)
        ly = sum(s[1] for s in samples) / len(samples)
        lz = samples[-1][2]
        dx, dy = hx - lx, hy - ly
        log(f"align {i}: lower {lx:.2f},{ly:.2f},{lz:.1f} err {dx:.2f},{dy:.2f}")
        if abs(dx) <= tol and abs(dy) <= tol:
            return True
        # clamp
        dx = max(-15, min(15, dx))
        dy = max(-15, min(15, dy))
        # step in <=20 mm pieces (already clamped)
        r = step("right", dx, dy, 0)
        log(f"  step {r.text}")
        if not r.ok:
            return False
    vis = locate()
    if "peg" not in vis:
        return False
    lx, ly, lz = vis["peg"]["low"]
    log(f"align end lower {lx:.2f},{ly:.2f},{lz:.1f}")
    return abs(hx - lx) < 2.5 and abs(hy - ly) < 2.5

def insert():
    # lift clear
    cx, cy, cz = tcp("right")
    move("right", cx, cy, max(cz, 170))
    # go above hole
    move("right", 0, 60, 170)
    if not align_to_hole(170):
        log("align high failed, continuing")
    # drop to just above contact, then realign (xy drifts with height)
    cx, cy, cz = tcp("right")
    move("right", cx, cy, 115)
    if not align_to_hole(115):
        log("align low imperfect, continuing")
    # press in
    stalled = 0
    last_z = tcp("right")[2]
    for i in range(18):
        r = step("right", 0, 0, -4)
        log(f"insert {i}: {r.text}")
        m = re.search(r"z=([-\d.]+).*Fz=([+-]?[\d.]+)", r.text)
        if not m:
            if not r.ok:
                break
            continue
        z = float(m.group(1))
        fz = float(m.group(2))
        if abs(z - last_z) < 0.6:
            stalled += 1
        else:
            stalled = 0
        last_z = z
        if abs(fz) > 8 and stalled >= 1:
            log("contact stall, releasing")
            break
        if z < 62 and abs(fz) > 6:
            log("depth + force, releasing")
            break
    grip("right", "open")
    # back off
    cx, cy, cz = tcp("right")
    move("right", cx, cy, 180)
    vis = locate()
    log("post-release vision: " + vis["raw"].replace("\n", " | "))
    if "peg" in vis:
        lowz = vis["peg"]["low"][2]
        tilt = vis["peg"]["tilt"]
        log(f"lower z={lowz:.1f} tilt={tilt:.1f}")
        if lowz > 22:
            log("not seated, pushing top")
            push_top(vis)
            vis = locate()
            log("after push: " + vis["raw"].replace("\n", " | "))
    return vis

def push_top(vis):
    c = vis["peg"]["c"]
    # top of 90 mm peg is ~45 mm above centre
    top_z = c[2] + 45
    grip("right", "close")
    move("right", c[0], c[1], top_z + 40)
    move("right", c[0], c[1], max(100, top_z - 5))
    # press down a bit
    for i in range(8):
        r = step("right", 0, 0, -3)
        log(f"push {i}: {r.text}")
        m = re.search(r"Fz=([+-]?[\d.]+)", r.text)
        if m and abs(float(m.group(1))) > 12:
            break
    grip("right", "open")
    cx, cy, cz = tcp("right")
    move("right", 80, 20, 200)

def run():
    log("=== trial start ===")
    r = workcell.call("trial", "start")
    log(r.text)
    if not r.ok:
        return 1
    log("time " + robot_time())
    log(status_text())

    log("--- remove cap ---")
    r = workcell.robot("pick", "cap", "--arm", "left")
    log(r.text)
    if not r.ok:
        log("cap pick failed")
        end()
        return 1
    r = workcell.robot("place", "bin", "--arm", "left")
    log(r.text)
    if not r.ok:
        log("cap place failed")
        end()
        return 1
    # park left
    move("left", -180, -10, 300)
    log("time after cap " + robot_time())

    log("--- grasp peg ---")
    if not grasp_peg():
        log("FAILED to grasp peg")
        end()
        return 1
    log("time after grasp " + robot_time())

    log("--- insert ---")
    insert()
    # park right clear of socket
    move("right", 160, -10, 280)
    move("left", -180, -10, 300)
    log("time before end " + robot_time())
    log(workcell.robot("scene").text)
    return end()

def end():
    r = workcell.call("trial", "end")
    log("=== trial end ===")
    log(r.text)
    log(workcell.call("trial", "status").text)
    return 0 if r.ok else 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(run())
